blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tropical Storm Queenie has maintained its strength while moving over the Philippine Sea east of extreme northern Luzon, the state weather bureau reported on Friday. Based on the 5 a.m. Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) weather bulletin, Queenie is still carrying a maximum sustained wind speed of 75 kilometers per hour (kph) near the center and gustiness of up to 90 kph. Located 1,065 kilometers east of Extreme Northern Luzon, the tropical storm is currently moving northwestward at 20 kph.
